description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {3}{G}{U}, targeting a permanent.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Doppelgang, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
